title.es: Reunión de convivencia en el piso

es: Mantener una reunión de convivencia: exponer un problema, discrepar con tacto de dos propuestas, reformular un malentendido y cerrar una regla común verificable.

teaching.en: I'd like to raise a problem: the flat is very noisy late at night.
teaching.es: Quisiera plantear un problema: el piso es muy ruidoso por la noche.
teaching.explanationEs: I'd like to raise a problem abre el tema sin culpar a nadie.
segments: I'd like to raise a problem: the
flat is very noisy late at night.
teaching.audioText: I'd like to raise a problem: the flat is very noisy late at night.

teaching.en: I see what you mean, but I'm not sure a ban on guests is fair.
teaching.es: Veo lo que dices, pero no estoy seguro de que prohibir las visitas sea justo.
teaching.explanationEs: Suavizador + but + duda: discrepas con tacto de una propuesta.
segments: I see what you mean, but I'm not
sure a ban on guests is fair.
teaching.audioText: I see what you mean, but I'm not sure a ban on guests is fair.

teaching.en: I'd have thought we could find a compromise, couldn't we?
teaching.es: Habría pensado que podríamos encontrar un término medio, ¿no?
teaching.explanationEs: I'd have thought + cola: expresas sorpresa y pides confirmar.
teaching.audioText: I'd have thought we could find a compromise, couldn't we?

teaching.en: If I understood you correctly, you want guests to leave by eleven.
teaching.es: Si te he entendido bien, quieres que las visitas se vayan a las once.
teaching.explanationEs: If I understood you correctly reformula lo que oíste para comprobarlo.
segments: If I understood you correctly, you
want guests to leave by eleven.
teaching.audioText: If I understood you correctly, you want guests to leave by eleven.

teaching.en: I think there's a misunderstanding: I want a rule, not a ban.
teaching.es: Creo que hay un malentendido: quiero una norma, no una prohibición.
teaching.explanationEs: A rule es una norma acordada; a ban es una prohibición total.
segments: I think there's a misunderstanding: I
want a rule, not a ban.
teaching.audioText: I think there's a misunderstanding: I want a rule, not a ban.

teaching.en: To sum up, we have an agreement: guests leave by eleven on weekdays.
teaching.es: Para resumir, tenemos un acuerdo: las visitas se van a las once entre semana.
teaching.explanationEs: To sum up cierra la reunión con una frase que todos pueden verificar.
segments: To sum up, we have an agreement:
guests leave by eleven on weekdays.
teaching.audioText: To sum up, we have an agreement: guests leave by eleven on weekdays.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo planteas un problema sin culpar a nadie?

choices.text: You are the problem: your guests are loud.
I'd like to raise a problem: the noise is bad at night.

feedback.es: I'd like to raise a problem presenta el tema con educación y sin señalar a una persona.

hint.es: Plantea el problema sin señalar a ninguna persona.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si te he entendido bien, quieres una norma para los cubos.»

feedback.es: If I understood you correctly reformula lo que oíste; understood es el pasado de understand.

hint.es: Es el pasado del verbo understand.

origin.text: If I ___ you correctly, you want a rule for the bins.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Creo que hay un malentendido sobre la fiesta.»

answer.text: I think there's a misunderstanding about the party

feedback.es: Un malentendido se introduce con I think there's a misunderstanding.

hint.es: Abre con I think y termina con el tema de la fiesta.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con su fase de la reunión.

pairs: I'd like to raise a problem…
I'm not sure a ban is fair.

feedback.es: Cada fórmula abre, cuestiona, aclara o cierra un momento distinto de la reunión.

pairs: I'd like to raise a problem…
I'm not sure a ban is fair.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué problema plantea Mia.

choices.text: Nobody empties the bins on time.
Tom wants a rota for the bins.
Leo is upset about the noise.

feedback.es: Mia dice que los cubos están llenos cada lunes: nadie los saca a tiempo.

origin.audio: Mia says: I'd like to raise a problem. The bins are full every Monday. Leo answers: I see what you mean, but I'm not sure a rota is fair on Tom.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para resumir, la nueva norma es salir a las once.»

feedback.es: To sum up cierra la reunión con un resumen de lo acordado.

origin.text: To sum ___, the new rule is to leave at eleven.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué acuerdo se resume.

choices.text: Everyone cleans the kitchen on Sundays.
The person who leaves the kitchen last cleans it.
Nobody cleans the kitchen at night.

feedback.es: El resumen dice que la última persona en la cocina la limpia: es la norma que todos pueden verificar.

origin.audio: To sum up, we have an agreement: the last person in the kitchen cleans it. Is that right?

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta discrepa con tacto y ofrece un compromiso?

choices.text: I suppose so, as long as nobody visits.
I see what you mean, but I'm not sure a ban is fair. How about guests until eleven?

feedback.es: Solo una respuesta suaviza el desacuerdo con un suavizador y propone un compromiso (visitas hasta las once). Las otras atacan o aceptan con reservas.

origin.text: Tom: “Let's ban all guests at night.”

prompt.es: Completa: «Habría pensado que encontraríamos un término medio, ¿no?»

feedback.es: I'd have thought expresa sorpresa tentativa; después de have va el participio.

origin.text: I'd have ___ we could find a compromise, couldn't we?

prompt.es: Escribe tu intervención en la reunión del piso (unas 80–100 palabras).

answer.text: I'd like to raise a problem: for a month the flat has been noisy until one in the morning, and the dishes stay in the sink. Tom, I see what you mean, but I'm not sure a ban on guests is fair. Mia, I'd have thought a daily rota was too much, wouldn't it? If I understood you correctly, you both want a calmer flat. So how about this rule: guests leave by eleven on weekdays, and the last person in the kitchen washes up? To sum up, that works for everyone, doesn't it?
accepted: I'd like to raise a problem: for a month the flat has been noisy until one in the morning, and the dishes stay in the sink. Tom, I see what you mean, but I'm not sure a ban on guests is fair. Mia, I'd have thought a daily rota was too much, wouldn't it? If I understood you correctly, you both want a calmer flat. So how about this rule: guests leave by eleven on weekdays, and the last person in the kitchen washes up? To sum up, that works for everyone, doesn't it?

I'd like to raise a problem: the flat has been very noisy until one in the morning, and the dishes stay dirty. Tom, I see what you mean, but I'm not sure a ban on guests is the answer. Mia, I'm not sure a daily rota is fair, to be honest. If I understood you correctly, you both want a quieter flat. What if we had a rule: guests leave by eleven on weekdays and the person who leaves the kitchen last washes up? That would work for everyone, wouldn't it?

I'd like to raise a problem. We have noise until one in the morning and dirty dishes every day. Tom, I see it differently: I'd tend to think a ban on guests is too strong. Mia, a rota every day seems a lot, doesn't it? If I understood you correctly, you both want peace and a clean kitchen. How about a rule: guests leave by eleven on weekdays? To sum up, the last person in the kitchen washes up. Is that right?

feedback.es: Una intervención completa plantea el problema, discrepa con tacto de las dos propuestas, reformula y cierra con una regla verificable.

origin.text: Reunión del piso. Problema: desde hace un mes hay ruido hasta la 1 de la madrugada y los platos se acumulan. Propuesta de Tom: prohibir las visitas entre semana. Propuesta de Mia: un turno de limpieza diario. Expón el problema, discrepa con tacto de las dos propuestas, reformula lo que quieren y propón una regla común que cierres con una cola.

prompt.es: ¿Qué hace Tom ante el malentendido de Ana?

choices.text: He corrects it and explains what he means.
He refuses to talk about it.

feedback.es: Tom dice «No» y explica qué quiere de verdad: corrige el malentendido con una aclaración.

origin.text: Ana: “You want guests to leave by eleven, don't you?” Tom: “No, I want a rule for the weekend, not for every night.”

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué compromiso propone la persona.

choices.text: A ban on visits every Friday.
A rule that applies only on weekdays.
A rule for all days of the week.

feedback.es: Después de negarse a una prohibición, propone una norma solo para los días de entre semana.

origin.audio: I'm afraid I can't agree to a ban. I'd love to help, but the thing is, my sister stays here on Fridays. How about a rule only for weekdays?

prompt.es: Reformula con «If I understood you correctly» lo que dijo Sara.

answer.text: If I understood you correctly, nobody should wash up after eleven.
accepted: If I understood you correctly, nobody should wash up after eleven.
If I understood you right, nobody should wash up after eleven.
If I understood you correctly, nobody should wash the dishes after eleven.

feedback.es: If I understood you correctly + lo que crees que dijo la otra persona, para que confirme.

origin.text: Sara dijo: «Nadie debería fregar después de las once.» Reformúlalo para comprobar que lo has entendido bien.
